question: In which city will the 2024 Summer Olympic Games be held?
solution:
The correct answer is __Paris__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 2024 Summer Olympics is a forthcoming international multi-sport event that is scheduled to take place from 26 July to 11 August 2024 in Paris, France.
 
• Paris will become the second city to host the **Olympics three times, after London (1908, 1948, and 2012).
 
• The Olympic edition of 1900 and 1924 was hosted by Paris.
 
• The 2024 Games will mark the third time Paris has staged the Olympics, coming exactly 100 years after they last hosted the Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The Motto of 2024 Paris Games is *Games wide open.***
 
• 2022 Winter Olympics will be held in Beijing.
 
• The official Mascot of the 2022 Winter Olympics Games is Bing Dwen Dwen.
 
• 2020 Summer Olympics rescheduled to 2021 will be held in Tokyo, Japan.
 
• The official Mascot of the 2020 Summer Olympics Games is Miraitowa.
